title: 3 Ways To Earn Passive Income Using PancakeSwap
description: #shorts 3 Ways To Earn Passive Income Using PancakeSwap

asr.full_text: What's up future millionaires real quick so i have three ways that you can start earning passive income using pancake swap now this is not financial advice just for educational purposes now the first way is just by staking whichever staking pool you are staking your cake you are going to earn the apr in that cryptocurrency now secondly you add liquidity to the market which is the second way to earn passive income, where you take two cryptocurrencies or two tokens, for example, the CAKE token and the BNB coin, and you add that to one of the liquidity markets for traders. And then in return, you're going to get a flat fee and you will receive passive income in LP tokens, which takes us to the third way. Now LP token stands for liquidity provider tokens. Now those LP tokens you can actually stake those in the LP farm token. So you have regular staking, add liquidity to the market and then you actually stake your LP tokens that you get for adding liquidity.
